Dear {vendor} team,

This is formal written notice that Brightwater Coffee Co. does not wish to renew {agreement}, and we are giving notice of non-renewal under its terms. The current term ends on {term_end}, and we ask that the agreement not renew at that time.

The agreement states: "{notice_clause}". We are providing this notice within that period, before {deadline}.

Please confirm in writing that you have received this notice of non-renewal and that {agreement} will end on {term_end} without renewal. Please also let us know if you need anything further from us to process this request.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Best regards,
{sender}
